title: Week 09 · What We Shipped: ParcelIQ & More
excerpt: Domain migration, dynamic articles pipeline, weekly cron publish, and a bunch of fixes — what actually shipped this week.
content:
## What We Shipped This Week

A busy week of infrastructure, pipelines, and polish across multiple projects.

### ingramgeoai.com is Live
Migrated the portfolio site from GitHub Pages subdirectory to a proper custom domain. Set up Cloudflare DNS, wired up GitHub Pages, and got HTTPS running via Cloudflare's Universal SSL.

### Weekly Article Pipeline
Built an end-to-end article publishing pipeline: a build log lives at `~/Desktop/tr-jig/build-log/current-week.md`, a Python script reads it, sends it through Ollama (qwen2.5:14b) for formatting, pushes the result to GitHub via the Contents API, and resets the log. Runs automatically every Sunday night via cron.

### ParcelIQ Fixes
Fixed a filter panel overflow on mobile, cleaned up the draw banner CSS, and confirmed all production URLs are stable.

### OpenClaw Ops
All four cron jobs healthy: bookmark-digest, gitmap-nightly, 8bit-stoic-daily, projectiq-native-nightly. Dashboard running on Tailscale at port 4242.

### Pain Points
- GitHub Pages custom domain cert provisioning is opaque — no API to force it, just wait.
- Context compaction mid-session can leave stale tool IDs in the conversation (fixed with gateway restart).
- CNAME files in gh-pages branches are sneaky — easy to forget they exist and cause redirect loops.

title: Week 08 · Shipping ParcelIQ: From Zero to Production on Cloudflare
excerpt: Built a full GIS parcel map app in ~90 minutes of active coding — 46k parcels, AI search, draw & query, color ramps, mobile-first UI. Here's what worked, what broke, and what we learned.
content:
## ParcelIQ: Built in ~90 Minutes

ParcelIQ is a Laramie County Wyoming parcel map — 46,000 parcels, full attribute search, AI-powered NLP queries, and a mobile-first UI. The core app went from zero to production in about 90 minutes of active coding.

### The Stack
- **Cloudflare Pages** — frontend hosting, free tier
- **Cloudflare Worker** — API layer with rate limiting and CORS
- **Cloudflare D1** — SQLite at the edge, stores all 46k parcel records
- **Cloudflare R2** — serves the PMTiles vector tile file
- **MapLibre GL JS** — map rendering
- **Workers AI** — NLP search via llama-3.1-8b-instruct

### Features Shipped
- Symbology switcher: Actual Value / Assessed / $/Acre / Acreage
- 6 color ramp presets with dark/light variants
- Draw & Query: polygon draw → bbox query → highlighted parcels + stats
- CSV export
- Filter sliders (value range + acreage range)
- Owner portfolio view
- Shareable URLs with parcel pre-selection
- Legal disclaimer modal

### Pain Points
- Multi-origin CORS on Cloudflare Workers requires explicit `Vary: Origin` headers
- PMTiles source setup in MapLibre has a specific initialization order
- D1 batch inserts cap at 100 rows — need chunking for large datasets
- Aerial imagery proxy still broken (bbox comma encoding in ArcGIS exportImage)

### Live
**https://parcel-iq.org** — free, public, no login required.

title: Building Mission Control: How Our AI Agent System Works
excerpt: A deep dive into the architecture behind a personal AI agent running 24/7 on a Mac Mini — cron jobs, skills, memory, and pipelines that actually ship work.
content:
## Mission Control: Personal AI Infrastructure

A Mac Mini running 24/7 as a personal AI operations center. Here's what's actually running.

### The Core: OpenClaw
OpenClaw is the gateway — it routes messages from Discord, manages sessions, runs cron jobs, and gives the AI agent access to tools: file system, shell, browser, camera, messaging, and more.

### The Agent
Claude Sonnet 4 running as the main agent. Persistent memory via markdown files in a workspace directory. Identity, soul, and operating rules defined in SOUL.md and AGENTS.md. Wakes up each session and reads its memory files.

### The Pipelines
- **bookmark-digest** — runs at 8am and 8pm, pulls Twitter bookmarks, runs expert analysis through Ollama (qwen2.5:14b), delivers a filtered digest
- **8bit-stoic-daily** — generates a daily stoic quote with pixel art, posts to Discord
- **gitmap-nightly** — maps GitHub activity overnight
- **projectiq-native-nightly** — project status tracking

### Local AI: Ollama
qwen2.5:14b running locally on the Mac Mini handles formatting, summarization, and digest generation. No API costs for the heavy lifting.

### The Philosophy
The goal isn't to automate everything — it's to automate the boring parts so the interesting parts get more attention. Ship faster. Think less about infrastructure. Focus on the work.
